$comment: K7.6 upstream watch: the last upstream state we reviewed. scripts/upstream-watch.mjs compares each watch's pin with upstream and opens (or updates) one issue on pmndrs/vdb when something moved. Bump a pin only after the review its 'review' line asks for, in the same commit as any VENDOR.md / THIRD_PARTY.md / TASKS change it brings.

watches.name: OpenVDB / NanoVDB releases
watches.review: Release notes and nanovdb/nanovdb/PNanoVDB.h, NanoVDB.h, io/IO.h at the new tag: ABI or file-format changes, new grid types, codecs. Re-pin packages/vdb/vendor/upstream/PNanoVDB.h (K7.5 recipe in VENDOR.md).

watches.name: mjurczyk/openvdb tags
watches.review: His changelog and diff since the pin: .wvdb format, renderer fixes and features we port (THIRD_PARTY.md rows, DIVERGES). Read his code; don't run it (CLAUDE.md).

watches.name: npm openvdb
watches.review: Published with the mjurczyk/openvdb tag of the same version; check the licence field still says MIT.

watches.name: npm three-openvdb
watches.review: His three.js renderer package (the K3/K6 port's source); check the licence field still says MIT.

watches.name: npm webvdb
watches.review: His .wvdb CLI (baker); a format change shows here first.

watches.name: emcfarlane/webgpu-nanovdb commits
watches.review: Changes to pnanovdb.wgsl: diff against our fork (packages/vdb/vendor/VENDOR.md diff log); a fix to an upstream line we also fixed (DIVERGES V14) lets us drop ours.
